protocol.name: local-ruler-13-v1
adaptations: Pinned upstream task-construction functions with deterministic per-case seeds and binary sizing of complete examples.
Shared NVIDIA chat template, thinking off, assistant answer prefix; 256-token output cap for all tasks.
Four cases/task/length, not a full published RULER run. QA indices shared across lengths; other length controls need not share identical golds.
Essay distractors repeated if needed at 1M. CWE vocabulary cap retained; undersized examples explicitly excluded from near-window macro summaries.
No silent truncation, retry-based answer selection or kernel/precision changes.

environment.torch: not installed or required by this HTTP evaluation client

scope: All files and prompt hashes verified before scoring. NIAH literal gold values are present. Character positions are approximate locations, not token positions. CWE and SQuAD are corpus-limited below 1M and excluded from near-1M aggregates.
